cluster: rhombic torus of 24 x 24 three-site unit cells, edge vectors 24 a1 and 24 a2 (a1 = (2, 0), a2 = (1, sqrt3)), the pattern of kagome-8x8_192_P and kagome-12x12_432_P. Defined by arXiv:1712.04579: 'we consider toric clusters that are defined by T1 = La1 and T2 = La2, and thus consist of N = 3L2 sites' (Sec. I), 'All the clusters are of the type 3xLxL' (Tables S1, S2). The spin Hamiltonian is periodic; the 'mixed boundary conditions, i.e., anti-periodic along a1 and periodic along a2' of the table captions are those of the fermionic state before projection. Created for the table column printed '1768', which is the 24 x 24 cluster of 1728 sites (see convention_check)

verified.note: Supplemental Material Table S1, row J_down/J_up = 1.0, column '1768' (sources/1712.04579.txt line 509); version read: arXiv text (sources/1712.04579.txt, v of 2018-03-16); journal version not read | Eq. (1): H = J_up sum S_i.S_j + J_down sum S_i.S_j with spin-1/2 operators; at J_down/J_up = 1.0 the nearest-neighbour kagome Heisenberg model; energies printed as E/J per site, S.S convention (RULES.md 5). Implied, not stated (RULES.md 8): the column headed 1768 is the 1728-site cluster. The paper states N = 3L^2 and 'All the clusters are of the type 3 x L x L' (Tables S1, S2), and 'L = 4n with n ranging from 1 to 7' (Sec. III). The seven printed columns 48, 192, 432, 768, 1200, 1768, 2352 are n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (6), 7; 3(4n)^2 gives 1728 for n = 6, and 1768 is 3L^2 for no integer L (L = 24.28). Only n = 6 is missing from the printed sequence, so the printed 1768 is a misprint of 1728. Plausibility: the value lies between the printed 1200- and 2352-site values of the same row.
